items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: They showed me a guard, a fellow they called "Train". His name was Colger.

ctx.x: And you went there. Okay. What was it like when you first, well, showed up at 'Bama State? What, can you give us an idea of what kinds of things happened?

Well, I was still doing the Lennie's Temple. They had, the word got out about music for me there. And, I was in the gymnasium putting on football togs to go out and go for the football team. So, when I got out there, they said no. You go to the band room. I was weighing about 165 lbs., I suppose. I said no. I want to play football. And, I insisted on playing football. I said I'll go to the band room later. But, I want to play football.
